milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The smithing table is at spawn-relative (5, 1, 7) inside the workshop building. max_distance=5 ensures the player has actually entered the building (door is at z=4, smithing table at z=7, so the player must be inside or at the doorway to be within 5 blocks). facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking toward the smithing table, modeling 'the player has found and is observing it'. This is preferred over position_inside_box because find tasks should verify the player can see the target, not just be in a region.

Uses inventory_has because this is a mine task — when polished granite stairs are mined with a pickaxe (iron pickaxe is provided), they drop themselves as an item that enters the player's inventory. Two blocks are available at spawn-relative (7,1,8) and (7,2,8); the player needs to mine at least one. inventory_has is the preferred rule type for mine tasks since the mined drop ends up in inventory and is not in the starting inventory (only iron_pickaxe is given).
